title: Integrate amplify crates into feature/amplify-engine; make check covers them; docs (PR prep)
description:
Integrate the Amplify-engine work for the PR into `develop` (scope: the comment on epic virt-f64188).

1. The lead merges `feature/amplify-crates` and `feature/amplify-appsync` into `feature/amplify-engine`, resolving conflicts in `rust/Cargo.toml` members and `Cargo.lock`.
2. `rust/Cargo.toml`: `[workspace] members = [".", "crates/virtuus-amplify", "crates/virtuus-appsync"]`.
3. The Makefile `check-rust` also runs, for each crate: `cargo clippy -p <crate> --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo test -p <crate>`, and `cargo tarpaulin -p <crate> --exclude-files 'src/*' --fail-under 100`.
4. `tools/check_spec_parity.py` treats `features/amplify/` and `features/appsync/` as `@rust-only` (they are tagged) and still passes.
5. README / docs: a short section on the two crates (what they are, and how Apricity uses them), in the repo's doc style.
6. `make check PYTHON=$PWD/.venv/bin/python` exits 0 on the merged branch. Paste the summary.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Root rust/tests/cucumber.rs now compiles. V2b's Rust steps had never been compiled: some were duplicates (ambiguous) or hollow (the YAML include steps were empty). Removed them. The five Python-backend include scenarios in errors.feature, which load 'the python database', are now tagged @python-only. 'I attempt to load the schema' caught panics, which from_schema no longer raises; it now matches on the Result. main() now filters @python-only, @bench and the amplify/appsync folders, and exits non-zero on failure. Every scenario this branch added passes in Rust; 15 failures from develop remain → virt-e75e2f. Removed the no-op CUCUMBER_FILTER_TAGS env from the Makefile.
